scope: Bounded Table 29 catalog-entry matrix against effective ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3, current reader/host consumers, linked clause evidence and current assertions. This is not a certification of each linked clause or every possible catalog value.

source.table: §7.7.2 Table 29, physical pp.113–117 / printed pp.98–102; §7.7.2 prose physical p.112 / printed p.97. Physical page numbers are verified against printed footer via extracted page layout, not inferred from formfeed count.

ec3_table29_annotations.effect: Strikes three Table 29 indirect-reference requirements for Dests, Outlines, Threads; no blanket reader rejection obligation follows.
Caret adds 'shall be a direct object' to Extensions.
Caret adds invalid catalog Lang handling as unknown, with reference to §14.9.2.
Text note clarifies text includes PDF text strings and textual content.
Caret adds indirect-reference requirement to StructTreeRoot.
Caret marks SpiderInfo deprecated in PDF 2.0.
Caret adds indirect-reference requirement to DPartRoot.
Amends §7.5.7 prohibition on putting encrypted-document catalog in an object stream; not a Table 29 cell edit.

unreviewed_or_limited: This is a Table 29 entry matrix, not a re-review of every linked clause or exhaustive values for each entry.
Legal and DSS were mapped to existing owners but not independently re-audited in this pass.
No direct-vs-indirect public control was added for Dests or URI; these are optional assertion gaps and no implementation failure was found.
Direct /AA tests already exercise all five document trigger moments, while the draft concerns only indirect representation.
